description: This file defines the CandidateVacancyDecorator class, which provides methods to manipulate and retrieve information related to CandidateVacancy entities within the OrangeHRM recruitment system. It includes methods to set associated Vacancy and Candidate objects by ID and to get the status of the candidate vacancy in a specific format.

classes.name: CandidateVacancyDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for CandidateVacancy entities, providing methods to set related Candidate and Vacancy by ID and to retrieve formatted vacancy status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the CandidateVacancyDecorator with a CandidateVacancy entity.

methods.name: setVacancyById
methods.description: Sets the Vacancy associated with the CandidateVacancy by Vacancy ID.

methods.name: setCandidateById
methods.description: Sets the Candidate associated with the CandidateVacancy by Candidate ID.

methods.name: getCandidateVacancyStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of the CandidateVacancy as an array with id and label.
